notes.title: FIXED Steam Items, I Promise This Time.
notes.notes:
[p]Steam items are weird man, it doesn't like to be checked more than once per session I guess.
I hope this fixed it.

I think this should fix it, here's a recap

Blue Hat: +5 HP
Red Hat: +10 HP
Gold Coin: +25 HP

Extra items do NOT stack! So max bonus is: +40 HP
[/p][p]PLEASE NOTE: NEW ITEM NAMES, ICONS, AND DESCRIPTIONS MAY TAKE SEVERAL DAYS OR WEEKS FOR STEAMS BACK-END TO LOAD THEM, YOU MAY SEE STRANGE/WRONG ICONS, DESCRIPTIONS, AND ITEM NAMES UNTIL THEY ARE UPDATED.[/p]

notes.title: Steam Inventory Items Added!

Added 3 steam inventory items, or rather, finished them!
Blue Hat: +5 Health
Red Hat: +10 Health

Items are unlocked automatically by playing and can be traded on the item store!

notes.title: DXP Events Re-Activated
notes.notes:
DXP Events Re-Activated:
Now uses system date & time, yes this means you could easily hack it by changing your system date and time, however I hope you prefer your apps to work normally instead haha.

notes.title: DXP Events Removed (For Now)
notes.notes:
DXP Events Removed (For Now):
Removing DXP events because getting the time from a server is buggy and possibly a future liability if the server changes owners.
Might re-add using system date and time later.

notes.title: Steam Cloud Save Fixed, Back-end Code Cleaned Up A Bit
notes.notes:
Steam Cloud Save Fixed: fixed bug with steam cloud not saving proper exp for level when resetting level or going to main menu

Back-end Code Cleaned Up A Bit: Fixed (some) of the back-end issues with the game, split the zombie types correctly, saving on game file size.

notes.title: Valentines Day DXP Event Started Early |HP Fix| Zombay Now On Itch IO in WebGL!
notes.notes:
DXP valentines day started early!
Fixed health points showing decimals in game!
Out now on itch with x10 exp! (but no saving, and only 3 swarm levels!) 
Play here: https://manbearpigman.itch.io/zombay-webgl

notes.title: Total Exp Fixed
notes.notes:
1. Total EXP fixed: was not adding bonus EXP from finishing clear modes (for this to calculate properly you may need to delete your saved game!)
2. Added some back-end stuff for a skill tree overhaul in the near future.

notes.title: Shield Gun Buff & Golden Guns DLC Backend
notes.notes:
1. Shield Gun now reduces damage by 1/3 instead of 1/2 when holding right-click
2. Added melee "woosh" sound
3. Golden Gun skins added on back end for DLC coming soon!

notes.title: Hit Settings & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
1. "Hit Sound" setting added
2. "Hit Marker" (visual) setting added
3. Fixed P90 red dot sight (hard to see through)
4. Fixed projectiles (explosive and bullet) not receiving damage boost from skill tree
5. Fixed more safe spots in industrial, hangar a & hangar b in clear & swarm modes

notes.title: Skill Tree & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
1. Added a skill tree with health/regen and ammo/reload upgrades respectively, player gains 1 skill point per level. Max skills right now = 150 skill points totals, but player may gain more for future updates.
2. FPS counter will now toggle in real time on main menu when using the setting
3. Fixed empty ammo "click" sound not playing correctly on turrets or automatic guns

notes.title: Safe Spot Fixes, Empty Ammo Sound, & More Main Menu UI
notes.notes:
1. Fixed safe spots in Hangar B (swarm mode)
2. Fixed a safe spot in Flooding (swarm mode)
3. Fixed a map escape spot on Industrial (swarm mode)
4. Added empty ammo sound when trying to shoot with 0 ammo
5. Added "EXP multiplier" to player stats on main menu
6. Added text to notify player about guns past lvl 60 requiring DLC purchase (if not purchased)

notes.title: Fixed Safe Spot On Tower
notes.notes: That's right, no fun for you cheaters :)

notes.title: Uh okay, Steam, be that way
notes.notes: Dunno what the heck just happened with steam but something on their end got messed up with the main branch upload and wasn't loading levels. I opened a testing branch, saw that it was indeed working, switch it back to main and everything seems to be kosher now.

notes.title: Melee Attack
notes.notes: Melee attacks added for non-akimbo guns (single wield guns) & will only do 1 point of damage per hit. I might play with the damage in a later update.

notes.title: Tower Level DLC (Coming Soon!)
notes.notes: Added a new, unique, swarm mode level DLC that will be available soon!
